Management Plan
- Suspected acute gastroenteritis. Advise oral rehydration with electrolyte solution (e.g., Dioralyte/ORS; OTC). Emphasize clear fluids and soft diet (soup, mashed foods), then gradual diet advancement as tolerated. Continue Paracetamol for fever/pain as needed (dose/route/frequency not documented). Avoid alcohol during recovery. Monitor for dehydration and symptom progression. If symptoms do not improve within 48 hours or if signs of dehydration develop, contact clinician for reassessment and potential further investigations.
